newsitem.title: USA: Applebee's Hill to become co-CEO in Jan..
newsitem.headline: Applebee's Hill to become co-CEO in Jan..

text.p: Applebee's International Inc said Monday Lloyd Hill would assume the role of co-chief executive officer with Abe Gustin, the company's chairman and chief executive, effective January 1, 1997.
It said Hill would retain his current positions as president and chief operating officer.

Gustin and Hill will share responsibilities of chief executive through 1997. Beginning in 1998, Gustin will retain his position as chairman of the board, while Hill will remain chief executive officer.
Earlier, the casual dining restaurant company reported third-quarter earnings of $0.35 per share, up from $0.28 per share in the same period a year ago.
At September 29, the chain was comprised of 781 Applebee's restaurants, including 144 company-owned or operated, and 637 franchise operated.
The company expects at least 160 Applebee's restaurants to open in 1996, consisting of 30 company-owned units and at least 130 franchise restaurants.
It said expansion plans for the Rio Bravo Cantina concept are on target. At the end of the third quarter, there were 22 such restaruants, including 19 that were company owned or operated.

During the quarter, four restaurants opened, each located in a new market for Rio Bravo Cantina. The company expects 16 Rio Bravo Cantinas to open in 1996, consisting of six company-owned restaurants and 10 franchise outlets.
